phasePolicy.interpretation: Deterministic rolling-headroom reconstruction using actual request starts. This is phase selection eligibility, not measured job enqueue-to-dispatch wait. Backlog, higher-priority work, scope eligibility and financial protection also constrain dispatch; do not attribute every blocked millisecond as avoidable idle.

physicalOccupancy.interpretation: Observed low physical occupancy/average usage does not prove endpoint entitlement or absence of burst throttles. The two recorded provider errors are real; global provider saturation is not established.

saturatedOriginRetries.sourceMechanism: resolvePilotMigration reads confirmed seed transaction; absent creation CPI, reads canonical pool latest1000 signatures. A full page refuses origin completeness. seedOutcome sets60s defer; watch maintenance re-enqueues that same unverified signature when defer expires.
saturatedOriginRetries.certainty: The original signature is immutable evidence identity; the confirmed representation/latest history page can change through finality/correction/pruning, so this is deferred unverified identity, not permanent token exclusion.
saturatedOriginRetries.suggestedSmallestPostRunRepair: Reason-specific persisted raw-signature cooldown: first5min, repeated15min, honor existing deferUntil on discovery enqueue and restart. Expire cooldown by observed wall time/retention; different genuine signature for same base proceeds independently and can supply canonical proof. Activity alone must not cancel origin-unknown cooldown. Preserve reason/history and report deferred coverage.
saturatedOriginRetries.measuredAvoidableBound: 49starts/24large history pages is this interval total associated with two repeated seeds, not a guarantee every request can be removed. Keeping first attempts means at most45starts could have been avoided in this exact interval with no repeated same-signature attempt; the proposed5/15min policy conservatively saves fewer.

expectedProposedCooldownArithmetic.assumptions: Both initial attempts begin near run start, attempts each costtwo reads, neither new proof nor structural code change occurs; not provider-verified future savings.

sharedPreparationCoalescing.conclusion: Offline regression establishes shared wait coalescing. Chronological observations corroborate reduced metadata churn; differing activity/elapsed times prohibit matched-market performance attribution.

sameCaseChanges.unchangedStrategy: No rule thresholds or window duration changed in these sources. Explicit feature-only diagnostics were added at6668, so old primary-only and new explicit+primary counts are not interchangeable.

decision: Six is a tested configuration ceiling, not sustained six-scope usable-window capacity. Twelve was configured but never achieved. Unique audited/predictive coverage improved in later observed intervals, but markets/timing differ. Current request inefficiencies have narrow fixes; per-transaction burst completeness remains inadequate for demonstrated busy scopes.
uncertainty: No whole-market denominator, natural financial lifecycle, later-winner profitability or live simultaneous holding protection is established.
Historical repromotion flags include earlier runs; within-interval weak revisits are computed from actual earlier failures in the same source interval.
